abstract_sentences.text: Evaluation of Text to Speech (TTS) systems is challenging and resource-intensive.

evidence.anchor: challenging and resource-intensive

abstract_sentences.text: Subjective metrics such as Mean Opinion Score (MOS) are not easily comparable between works.

evidence.anchor: not easily comparable between works

abstract_sentences.text: Objective metrics are frequently used, but rarely validated against subjective ones.

evidence.anchor: rarely validated against subjective ones

abstract_sentences.text: Both kinds of metrics are challenged by recent TTS systems capable of producing synthetic speech indistinguishable from real speech.

evidence.anchor: synthetic speech indistinguishable from real speech

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we introduce Text to Speech Distribution Score 2 (TTSDS2), a more robust and improved version of TTSDS.

evidence.anchor: introduce Text to Speech Distribution Score 2

abstract_sentences.text: Across a range of domains and languages, it is the only one out of 16 compared metrics to correlate with a Spearman correlation above 0.50 for every domain and subjective score evaluated.

evidence.anchor: above 0.50 for every domain

abstract_sentences.text: We also release a range of resources for evaluating synthetic speech close to real speech: A dataset with over 11,000 subjective opinion score ratings; a pipeline for recreating a multilingual test dataset to avoid data leakage; and a benchmark for TTS in 14 languages.

evidence.anchor: a benchmark for TTS in 14 languages
only one out of 16 compared metrics
a pipeline for recreating a multilingual test dataset

statistical_analysis.aggregation_unit: For each of 20 systems, average MOS/CMOS/SMOS within each of CLEAN/NOISY/WILD/KIDS; compute rank correlation across the 20 system rows. Table 2 then averages over four domains.
statistical_analysis.denominators: Main correlation cells use 20 systems per domain×subjective score; LOOCV uses 3 training domains/1 held-out domain; multilingual proxy uses the 14 evaluated language datasets.
statistical_analysis.central_quantities: Means of human ratings, Spearman ρ for ranking, Pearson r for factor/metric associations and fit labels, Simple Mean versus Learned Weights LOOCV point scores.
statistical_analysis.dispersion: MOS/CMOS/SMOS tables use ± values, but the paper does not define their statistic; Table 3/4/5/8 and TTSDS2 Table 2 cells are mostly point estimates.
statistical_analysis.intervals: not_present: no confidence intervals or bootstrap intervals.
statistical_analysis.hypothesis_tests: Authors state all TTSDS/TTSDS2 correlations and all Table 8 factor correlations are significant at p<0.05; Figure 7 displays significant p<0.05 Spearman correlations. Test form and multiplicity correction are not reported.
statistical_analysis.regression: Linear regression learns factor weights for LOOCV; Figure 2 draws overall and domain-specific least-squares fits.
statistical_analysis.seed_level_repeats: not_present for metric/system scores; no random seed or repeat protocol is given.
statistical_analysis.decision_quantities: ρ>0.50, average ρ≈0.67, parity defined as MOS/CMOS within 0.05 of ground truth, and 3-of-4 LOOCV wins for Simple Mean.
statistical_analysis.interpretation: Statistical significance and practical substitution are distinct: §5 explicitly says TTSDS2 cannot replace subjective evaluation despite robust correlations.

evidence.anchor: Spearman correlation coefficients
linear regression
cannot replace, subjective evaluation

final_judgment.single_storyline: 在 one-to-many TTS 下，把 synthetic/real/noise 的多 factor feature distributions 经 W2 归一化为无监督 TTSDS2；以 speaker/domain-controlled listening tests 验证跨域 system ranking，再用等权 ensemble 和自动 pipeline 扩展到 14 languages。【p.3–10 §2–4】
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留四域构造、200 人 MOS/CMOS/SMOS protocol、20 systems、Table 2/3 主结果、Table 4/5 LOOCV、Algorithm 1、Figure 3 和不能替代 subjective evaluation 的边界。【p.5–10】
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Table 6、survey 原文/界面、Table 7/8、Figures 7/8、compute、XNLI thresholds 和 ethics approval 放在 p.15–20；这保留主结果可读性，但让域异质性、factor 贡献和跨语言过滤风险依赖 appendix。【p.15–20】
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 1 并排展示 feature replacement；高维/一维 W2 加 Eq. (1) 把距离映射到可解释的 0–100；Table 3 固定 domain×MOS/CMOS/SMOS 网格；Table 4/5 把等权 regularization 与 learned-weight instability 直接相连。【p.3–4、p.7–8】
final_judgment.largest_gap: 「16 metrics」「only in every condition」与 Table 3 row count 不一致；多语言证据是 Uriel+ proxy 而非 MOS；大部分相关是 point estimate；pipeline 没有复杂度、过滤误差或真实 contamination audit；p.8 还有「Here is the updated pipeline section...」编辑残留句。【p.2 §1.3；p.7 Table 3；p.8 §4；p.10 §4.2；p.20 §H】
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 评价器论文应让「一对多结构 → estimand → feature/metric 组合 → human 或外部 proxy 验证 → 失败检测与资源边界」连续出现，并在正文保留至少一个域级异质性证据。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合有明确 reference、distribution/ranking estimand 的 metric/benchmark 工作；只有 proxy distance、无 human labels 或只报告跨域平均时，结论必须限制在代理关系和已测域，不能外推为 perceptual equivalence 或 subjective replacement。
